Line content: Welcome to your first day on the job!
You, yes YOU(!) are now in control of the FATE OF THE WORLD.
Isn't that exciting? So glad you answered the Craigslist ad.
Before we get into some real fun, let's learn the basics.
After all, experience was in no way a prerequisite. Your pay will reflect that hahaha
I'm not kidding.
It's just kinda that we're a bit understaffed...what with the AI that used to be running this place went all hallucinatory and doomsday-y.
But we'd already fired all the humans as a cost-saving measure. So lucky you! You're candidate #1.
We set a low bar here hahahahahahahaha
Listen up, it's real simple:
Spin the WHEEL OF POWER. It creates POWER. Power runs the machines the world needs to survive.
So, far, so good?
You can build up more power faster by buying GENERATORS and building up CLICKING POWER.
But make sure you have enough PIPES as you go to pump heat away and prevent a meltdown.
Rotate elements so they align [mechanics specifics]. And remember: all of this costs money to run!
As you excel at your new role, you can add new towns to the network and continue providing sweet sweet electric excellence to our customers.
Alternatively, you could fail and poison the drinking water for entire metropolitan areas.
And before you ask, I'm not any kind of automation system. Nah. I'm just here for moral support! You'rrreee welcome!
Are ya ready?
Just kidding, it doesn't matter! Let's get this show on the road!
Aw, don't worry about that! Yet!
I believe in you! (I'm automated to say that.)
I'm sure you're doing your absolute best. Which I'm also a little afraid you are.
Consider my high hopes lowered.
Guess ya get what you pay for, huh?
Don't worry about it! The evil AI was still wayyy worse than you.
Maybe we should require some experience on the next Craigslist ad...
You'll pick it up! Maybe!
I mean, I guess there's always a learning curve...
Is it getting hot in here?
You do know that poisoning local water supplies is a crime? I mean, at least theoretically.
You can turn this around! For sure! Please!
Not sayinig you're not amazing at this but...please be careful.
Maybe we should rethink the automated training system...
Good thing I don't have a bit of my stomach, or that's where my heart would be!
My anxiety meter is only moderately freaking out.
I think I can confidently quantify this as BAD.
Who's worried? Not me! For sure!
That temperature sure is climbing...
Danger Will Robinson!
Well. That sure seems bad.
Now that's what I call a BIG oopsy.
Now, don't panic...Or do. Panicking seems appropriate.
Ooph. You're doing a pretty horrific job, huh?
Aghhh we're definitely getting sued.
It's too hot! We're at max temp here before she blows!
Wow, that sure was a nice world while we had it...Good thing there's a planet B!
Wait what...? I thought...Oh.
Well, shoot
